question: The annual incomes of Anand and Bharath are in the ratio 3 ∶ 5 and their annual expenses are in the ratio 1 ∶ 3. If each of them saves Rs. 10,000 at the end of the year, then the annual income of Bharath is:
solution:
Given:

Income ratio of Anand and Bharath =3 ∶ 5

Expenditure ratio of Anand and Bharath = 1 ∶ 3

Savings of Anand and Bharath = Rs. 10000

Concept used:

We will be using the concept of ratio.

Income = Expediuture + Saving

Calculation:

According to the question,

3x – y = 10000 ----(1)

5x – 3y = 10000 ----(2)

Subtract equation (1) from equation (2) after multiplying by 5 in equation (1) and multiplying by 3 in equation (2)

4y = 2000

⇒ y = 5000.......(3)

putting the value of eq. (3) in eq. (1)

⇒ 3x – 5000 = 10000

⇒ x = 15000/3

⇒ 5000

The annual income of Bharath is = 5x 

⇒ 5x → 5 * 5000 = 25000
